variables.name: MARQUEZ_API
variables.description: Base URL of the Marquez OpenLineage collector (see the docker compose yml file)

variables.name: OPENLINEAGE_NAMESPACE
variables.description: The OpenLineage job namespace the sink emits under

variables.name: WAREHOUSE_NAMESPACE
variables.description: OpenLineage dataset namespace for the warehouse Postgres (host:port of the 'postgres' compose service); the warehouse-lineage validate pipeline asserts this namespace exists in Marquez

variables.name: WAREHOUSE_NAMESPACE_ENCODED
variables.description: URL-encoded WAREHOUSE_NAMESPACE, used in the Marquez datasets REST path by the column-lineage validate pipeline (0006)
